INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

2. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.

3. When learning Desktop Publishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Desktop Publishing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Desktop Publishing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Desktop Publishing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing.

4. When learning Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

6. When learning Application Areas of ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Application Areas of ICT.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Application Areas of ICT.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Application Areas of ICT.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Application Areas of ICT.

7. When learning The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.
   D. Skip safety briefings for The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

9. When learning Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.

10. When learning Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces.

11. When learning Introduction to ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to ICT.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to ICT.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to ICT.

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Internet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
